title: Simulation 3D Vehicle
text: Implement vehicle in 3D environment, 4 inputs, {Type, PassVehMesh} sets Type Muscle; {Path to custom mesh, MeshPath}, {Color, VehColor} sets the color of vehicle, {Name, ActorName} sets the name of vehicle, {Sample time}, {Enable light controls} sets the option to control vehicle lights, {Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor} sets the headlight color, {High beam intensity, HighBeamIntensity}, {Low beam intensity, LowBeamIntensity}, {High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle}, {Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle}, {Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation} sets the left headlight beam orientation, {Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation} sets the right headlight beam orientation, {Brake light intensity, BrakelightIntensity}, {Reverse light intensity, ReverselightIntensity}, {Turn signal light intensity, SignallightIntensity}, {Period, SignallightPeriod} sets the turn signal light period, {Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth}, {Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} sets the vehicle initial translation zeros, {Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} sets the vehicle initial rotation zeros and {Initial array values to scale vehicle per part, Scale} sets the vehicle initial scale ones. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type, PassVehMesh
params.values: Type Muscle car (default) | Sedan | Sport utility vehicle | Small pickup truck | Hatchback | Box truck | Formula student vehicle

params.name: Path to custom mesh, MeshPath
params.values: Path to custom mesh /MathWorksSimulation/Vehicles/Muscle/Meshes/SK_MuscleCar.SK_MuscleCar (default) | valid path

params.name: Color, VehColor
params.values: Color of vehicle Red (default) | Orange | Yellow | Green | Blue | Black | White | Silver | Dazzle camouflage

params.name: Name, ActorName
params.values: Name of vehicle SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time -1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Enable light controls
params.values: Option to control vehicle lights off (default) | on

params.name: Headlight color [R,G,B], HeadlightColor
params.values: Headlight color [1,1,1] (default) | 1-by-3 vector of RGB triplet values

params.name: High beam intensity, HighBeamIntensity
params.values: High beam intensity 100000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Low beam intensity, LowBeamIntensity
params.values: Low beam intensity 60000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: High beam cone half angle, HighBeamConeAngle
params.values: High beam cone half angle 1.22 (default) | positive scalar less than pi/2

params.name: Low beam cone half angle, LowBeamConeAngle
params.values: Low beam cone half angle 1.22 (default) | positive scalar less than pi/2

params.name: Left headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], LeftHeadlightOrientation
params.values: Left headlight beam orientation [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 vector with values between -pi and pi

params.name: Right headlight beam orientation [Pitch, Yaw], RightHeadlightOrientation
params.values: Right headlight beam orientation [0,0] (default) | 1-by-2 vector with values between -pi and pi

params.name: Brake light intensity, BrakelightIntensity
params.values: Brake light intensity 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Reverse light intensity, ReverselightIntensity
params.values: Reverse light intensity 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Turn signal light intensity, SignallightIntensity
params.values: Turn signal light intensity 500 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Period, SignallightPeriod
params.values: Turn signal light period 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Pulse width, SignalPulseWidth
params.values: Pulse width 50 (default) | positive scalar less than 100

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
params.values: Vehicle initial translation zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | 5 -by- 3 array

params.name: Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
params.values: Vehicle initial rotation zeros( 5, 3 ) (default) | 5 -by- 3 array

params.name: Initial array values to scale vehicle per part, Scale
params.values: Vehicle initial scale ones( 5, 3 ) (default) | 5 -by- 3 array
